components.css: .ds-filter { --filter-accent: #4b78ff; --filter-selected: #285ed9; position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-width: 130px; } .ds-filter[data-tone='red'] { --filter-accent: #ff4b54; --filter-selected: #c33139; } .ds-filter[data-tone='yellow'] { --filter-accent: #ffda4d; --filter-selected: #725700; } .ds-filter-trigger { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 0 14px; color: #fff; background: var(--filter-accent); border: 0; border-radius: 20px; font: 660 10px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-trigger:hover { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-filter-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #86a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-filter[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-filter-trigger { border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; } .ds-filter-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 100%; left: 0; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; max-height: min(280px, 60vh); padding: 4px; overflow: auto; background: #fff; border: 0 solid var(--filter-accent); border-width: 0 1px 1px; border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(29 40 60 / 10%); } .ds-filter-option { display: flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 0 8px; color: #465166; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 12px 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-option:hover, .ds-filter-option:focus-visible { color: var(--filter-selected); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--filter-accent) 10%, white); outline: 0; } .ds-filter-option.is-selected { color: var(--filter-selected); font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview: BatasGO's lawyer workspace puts incoming matters first. Its visual language follows the supplied triage reference: a quiet, pale work surface, white panels, compact labels, and deliberate blue, red, and yellow accents for actions and quick scanning. The logo remains the brand signature; the interface itself stays practical and information-led.
keyCharacteristics: Queue-first hierarchy with clear risk and decision states.
Cool neutral surfaces and crisp panel outlines.
Inter typography and compact, tabular case details.
Strong blue for primary actions, red for decline and urgency, yellow for sorting.

rules.name: The Queue Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue, red, and yellow to distinguish controls and states; keep the surrounding workspace neutral.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Keep case identifiers, risk, and actions visually distinct from supporting summaries.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Reserve stronger elevation for hover and overlays; resting panels remain close to the canvas.

dos: Do keep the queue as the largest and first-read area.
Do label sample workspace data as a demo; it is not connected to live client records.
Do pair the yellow sort control with dark text.
Do preserve keyboard-visible focus and reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't present sample statistics or matter details as live account data.
Don't introduce additional accent colors without a clear risk or action meaning.
Don't hide the queue behind summary metrics or decorative charts.
